name: glossy_lobes
description: soft glossy blue lobes like lit bubbles, each one smooth dome with a pale highlight, nestled between translucent gold star webs whose pointed arms are shaded edge to edge and warm to orange at their small inner blades, faint sparkles over everything, on deep navy

reference.made_with: an escape-time render signed 'exoteric.roach.org' (Ultra Fractal by its look), 2560x1600

reuses: the bubble trap's lattice (bronze_packing) as the lobes: discs of radius 0.3 on a square lattice through [0.5, 0.5] every 1, read at entry on escaping orbits between 0.02 and 0.35 frames wide, painted a literal blue so they keep the reference's contrast under every map

bronze_packing's dome: a light on the disc's height at period 2, rings 1, so the tube's rising half lies across each disc and it lights as one smooth dome with a broad highlight, never a ring; an inverted height glow paints a pale rim
the inside channel wearing the same lobe, where a seat has interior components

shaded_blades' strip trap (the line Im(z) = 0.5 at 60 degrees, every 2, a tenth wide, its blades between 0.015 and 0.2 frames) as the gold webs: a flat gold from the map at 0.84, lit across each blade, its edges brightened by an inverted height glow, and the map's orange end on the late entries, the small blades crowding each star's core
glow_filaments' falloff glows on de: a gold halo 0.01 frames wide and a hair of light along the set, the veins showing through the webs
gilded_orbs' sparkles: a lattice of tiny discs, warm-white near the set and ice-white in the far field
the tone pass, at the reference's median and p10

notes: Added: nothing: a disc lattice domed at `period` 2 under `shaded_blades`' strip blades, on `de`, `inside` and the sparkle lattice

Lessons: The eleventh style is soft glossy blue lobes nestled between gold star webs with orange cores, and it went in with **no new primitive**: the lobes are `bronze_packing`'s disc lattice (radius 0.3 every 1, bounded at 0.02 to 0.35 frames) painted a literal blue and domed by a light on the height at `period` 2; the gold stars are `shaded_blades`' strip trap at a tenth of its width, painted flat gold from the map, lit across, with bright edges and the map's orange end on the late entries crowding each star's core; the veins, halo and sparkles are `glow_filaments`' and `gilded_orbs`' layers. Three lessons. **A light on a disc's height rings it at one band and domes it at period 2**: at `bands` 1 and `rings` 1 the tube's crest sits at half height, so every lobe drew as an eye with a dark centre; at `period` 2 only the tube's rising half lies across the disc and its crest is the middle, one soft dome with one highlight, which is what "glossy, not banded" needs. **A blade trap's coverage is its width and its `largest`, never its opacity**: at radius 0.18 and `largest` 0.3 the blades covered most of every frame, the tone pass turned their gold olive, and every one of the forty drafts read p90 ~0.50 against 0.68; at radius 0.1 and `largest` 0.2 the gaps open for the lobes and 24 of 40 hold. **The galleries hold no lobes, so the lattice supplies them**: at the scout's forty seats the set's interior fills at least 5% of the frame at 3 and none of it at 22, while the lattice covers 38–99% (median 82%) before the blades go on; its density is also what holds the black share, since at spacing 1.5 the navy gaps read black 0.20–0.24 against 0.118 and at spacing 1 the mid-blue domes fill them. Its locations are an ordinary gallery scout (`--max-ink 0.30`); the misses are frames with little gold (p90 ~0.55) or a dark gap left open (black).
